dataset.selection_rule: Take the 12 lowest SHA-256 digests of UTF-8 seed + NUL + config + NUL + original filename, without content, duration, quality, or output filtering. Order is ascending digest.

application.cli: python transcribe.py transcribe AUDIO --model MODELS/MODEL --language ru|fr --threads 4 --output OUTPUT --force

environment.processor: INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C; shared cloud VM; not user Mac

metric_definition.reference: Official FLEURS transcription column; raw_transcription retained separately
metric_definition.normalization: Unicode NFKC and casefold; keep Unicode letters, marks, numbers; replace punctuation/symbols with spaces; collapse whitespace. Accents and Cyrillic ё preserved. No number-word conversion or phonetic correction.
metric_definition.WER: Sum of minimum word-level substitutions+deletions+insertions divided by sum of reference words (micro-average, not mean clip WER).
metric_definition.CER: Same at Unicode character level on normalized strings, including their single word-separator spaces.
metric_definition.tie_breaking: When several alignments have same minimum cost: prefer substitution, then deletion, then insertion.
